Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Anand Kumar,Bhriguram Ji,Nilesh Kumar Dubey,Shashi Shekhar Maur
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed by learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State.
3.

This bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 159 of 2021, under Sections - 498A, 304B, 323, 507 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Gulhariya,
District- Gorakhpur with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
4. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.

Applicant is husband of deceased and their marriage has taken place in the month of February, 2018 and that allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased, made Mohit Nishad vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49928496/
1 against applicant are thoroughly false.

sentences.text: In postmortem report of deceased, except ligature mark, no other injury has been shown on the body of deceased and that cause of death is asphyxia due to ante-mortem injury.
Referring to postmortem report, it was pointed out that deceased has committed suicide.
It was stated that deceased was a lady of volatile nature and she has committed suicide in fit of rage.
Alleged incident took place on 01.02.2021 but first information report was lodged after two months on 06.04.2021 and no explanation for delay in F.I.R. has been shown.

It is further submitted that applicant is in jail since 10.04.2021 and thus he has already undergone detention of about three years and nine months but during trial no witness has been examined so far and thus trial of the case would take sufficient long time.
Lastly, it was stated that in case applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that deceased has suffered death other than under normal circumstances within seven years of her marriage.

6. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
7. The bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant - Mohit Nishad involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i.
The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

v. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
9. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 8.1.2025 SK Srivastava  Mohit Nishad vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49928496/
